resources.string: Fill in one or both. At home the app uses the home address; elsewhere, the external one.

Without networks listed, the app tries the home address first whenever it is on Wi-Fi. Adding your home networks picks the address faster. Reading the network name requires location permission and location turned on.
Could not read the Wi-Fi name. Make sure you are on Wi-Fi and that location is turned on.
This address uses plain http. Traffic, including your token, is not encrypted. Use it only on your home network.
Saved. Paste a new token to replace it.
In Home Assistant, open your user profile → Security → Long-lived access tokens → Create token. Copy it and paste it here.
The selected pipeline no longer exists. Using the default pipeline.
This Home Assistant version does not support automatic follow-up questions. Tap the mic to answer a question.
Enter the server address and access token in settings first.
The server address is not valid.
Plain http is allowed only for local addresses. Use https for this server.
The access token was rejected. Create a new token in Home Assistant and enter it in settings.
Cannot reach the server. Check the address and your network.
The connection to Home Assistant was lost.
Home Assistant did not answer in time.
No speech was detected. Tap the mic and try again.
The microphone could not be opened.
The app is not allowed to access devices on the local network. Allow it in the app settings (Permissions → Nearby devices / Local network).
